brief:
A Palestinian man and his adult son were injured in an attack by Israeli settlers in Bethlehem, according to Middle East Eye. Raed Khalil, 45, and his 24-year-old son Mahmoud sustained injuries during the incident, which occurred as settler violence continues across the occupied West Bank.

Palestinian media outlets and local activists have documented a series of attacks attributed to Israeli settlers operating in Palestinian areas. The incident involving Khalil and his son represents the latest in a pattern of violence that rights organizations and community monitors say persists throughout the territory, particularly affecting Palestinian civilians and their property in settlements and nearby regions.

title: Israeli settlers injure Palestinian father and son in Bethlehem
